idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        "app_main.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES nvs_flash esp_wifi esp_event esp_netif mqtt json esp_timer driver esp_driver_uart
             app_update esp_https_ota esp_http_client mbedtls
             ha_config ha_mqtt ha_ota ha_sntp ha_wifi ha_cse7766 ha_partmig
)
# The partition table this image was built for, embedded so ha_partmig can install it on a unit that arrives
# running Tasmota (ADR-0042). Generated by the build -> declare the dependency.
idf_build_get_property(build_dir BUILD_DIR)
set(_pt "${build_dir}/partition_table/partition-table.bin")
set_source_files_properties("${_pt}" PROPERTIES GENERATED TRUE)
target_add_binary_data(${COMPONENT_LIB} "${_pt}" BINARY
                       DEPENDS partition_table_bin)
